ينزعج (form VII)
# يَنْزَعِجُ (yanzaʕiju) /jan.za.ʕi.d͡ʒu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِنْزَعَجَ (inzaʕaja)
# يُنْزَعَجُ (yunzaʕaju) /jun.za.ʕa.d͡ʒu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِنْزَعَجَ (inzaʕaja)
# يَنْزَعِجَ (yanzaʕija) /jan.za.ʕi.d͡ʒa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْزَعَجَ (inzaʕaja)
